name: hiroba-firebase
description: 星軍基地の Firebase 設定・テスト・ブラウザ用の部品づくり

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hiroba --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/ensure-test-secret.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.emulators: node scripts/ensure-test-secret.mjs && firebase emulators:start --project demo-hiroba --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hiroba --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/ensure-test-secret.mjs && node test/e2e.mjs"
